# iliad-133 — new renderings (21.97–199)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ὣς ἄρα μιν Πριάμοιο προσηύδα φαίδιμος υἱὸς (21.97, whole-line speech introduction, Lycaon the speaker) | "So then to him Priam’s glorious son spoke," | "So Priam’s glorious son spoke to him," | "answered", "addressed" (reserved for προσέφη / προσεφώνεε); φαίδιμος "glorious" (4.505), υἱός kept as "son" |
| τὸν δ’ αὖ Πηλεγόνος προσεφώνεε φαίδιμος υἱός (21.152, whole-line speech introduction, reply) | "And him in turn addressed Pelegon’s glorious son:" | "Then Pelegon’s glorious son spoke to him in turn:" | "answered him" (drops αὖ "in turn"); προσεφώνεε "addressed" as in the table’s 3.389 and 3.413 rows; φαίδιμος "glorious" |
| ἀμείλικτον ὄπ’ ἄκουσε (21.98) | "an unsoftened voice he heard" | "the voice he heard was unyielding" | "pitiless" (reserved for νηλεής), "ungentle", "unyielding" in `l`; follows the table’s ἀμείλικτον `l` "unsoftened", `i` "unyielding" (11.137) |
| ἀκηδέες (21.123; of the fish) | "uncaring" | "uncaring" | "uncared for" (the Odyssey’s passive ἀκηδής, Odyssey 20.130, a corpse nobody tends), "careless", "heedless"; here the word is active, the fish having no concern for the dead man |
| ἀργέτα δημόν (21.127) | "white fat" | "white fat" | "bright fat", "shining fat"; ἀργής "white, bright" as in the Odyssey’s ἀργῆτι κεραυνῷ (the table’s ἀργῆτι) |
| θρῴσκων … ὑπαΐξει (21.126) | "leaping … will dart up" | "leaping, will dart up" | "will rise", "will leap up"; ὑπαΐσσω "dart up from below" |
| φθείρεσθ’ (21.128) | "Perish on" | "Go on perishing" | "Be damned", "Go to hell", "Rot" (each adds force the Greek does not state); φθείρομαι "perish, go to ruin" |
| ποταμός … ἐΰρροος ἀργυροδίνης (21.130) | "fair-flowing, silver-eddying" | "fair-flowing and silver-eddying" | "fine-flowing", "silver-swirling"; follows ἐϋρρεῖος (21.1, "fair-flowing") and the table’s ἀργυροδίνης "silver-eddying" (2.753) |
| καθίετε (μώνυχας ἵππους, 21.132) | "you let down" | "you let down" | "plunge", "throw", "drive"; καθίημι "let down" |
| κακὸν μόρον (ὀλέεσθε, 21.133) | "an evil doom" | "an evil doom" | "evil fate" (reserved for μοῖρα, αἶσα); the table’s 6.357 unchanged |
| κηρόθι μᾶλλον (χολώσατο, 21.136) | "enraged at heart the more" | "all the more enraged at heart" | "angered" (χόλος is "anger" but the verb in the table’s 3.413 is "enraged"), "in his breast"; κηρόθι "in the heart" (locative of κῆρ), as in the table’s 9.300 row |
| ἀλάλκοι (Τρώεσσι δὲ λοιγὸν ἀλάλκοι, 21.138) | "keep ruin away" | "keep ruin away from the Trojans" | "ward off" (reserved for ἀμύνω), "avert", "drive off"; λοιγόν "ruin" as in the table (1.341) |
| εὐρυρέεθρος (Ἀξιὸς, 21.141) | "of the wide stream" | "of the wide stream" | "wide-flowing" (kept for εὐρὺ ῥέων, 2.849 and 21.157), "broad-bedded", "wide-channelled"; εὐρύς "wide" + ῥέεθρον "stream" |
| γείνατο καὶ Περίβοια (21.142; one singular verb, two subjects) | "begot" | "was his father … his mother" (rebuilt in the sentence) | "bore" for both; the verb is the father’s verb and is kept as "begot" in `l` |
| μένος … θῆκε (21.145) | "put might" | "put might" | "strength", "fury", "courage"; μένος "might" as in the Odyssey table |
| δαϊκταμένων αἰζηῶν · ἐδάϊζε (21.146–147) | "the young men cut down" · "was cutting down" | "the young men who had been cut down" · "was cutting down" | "slain" (kept for ἐναίρω, κατακτείνω), "hacked", "butchered"; δαΐζω "cut down, hew" |
| ὣς φάτ’ ἀπειλήσας (21.161) | "So he spoke, threatening," | "So he spoke in threat" | "boasting", "vaunting" (each fixes a different sense); ἀπειλέω "threaten" |
| ἁμαρτῇ δούρασιν ἀμφὶς … περιδέξιος (21.162–163; the verb is left out) | "together, on both sides, with spears … skilled with both hands" | "threw with both his spears at once … skilled with either hand" | "ambidextrous" (a modern word), "with both hands at once" (it is both spears, not both hands), "right-handed all round"; the missing verb is supplied in `i` only, and the note says so |
| ἐρύκακε (δῶρα θεοῖο, 21.165) | "for gold held it back, gifts of the god;" (whole unit as published at 20.268) | "for the gold held it back, the gifts of the god;" | "held it off", "held the spear back" (the earlier draft); "stopped", "turned aside" (kept for ἀποτρέπω), "warded off" (kept for ἀμύνω); ἐρύκω "hold back" |
| ἐπιγράβδην (21.166) | "grazing" | "grazing" | "scratching", "slightly", "on the surface"; ἐπιγράφω "scratch on", the adverb in -δην |
| ἐνεστήρικτο λιλαιομένη χροὸς ἆσαι (21.168; the spear personified) | "was fixed, longing to glut itself on his flesh" | "stuck fast in the earth, longing to glut itself on his flesh" | "eager to be sated", "hungry for"; follows the table’s λιλαιομένη χροὸς ἆσαι "longing to glut" (11.574); "eager" is kept for ἱεμένη χροὸς ἄμεναι in iliad-132 (21.70) |
| ἰθυπτίωνα (μελίην, 21.169) | "flying straight" | "straight-flying" (+ note: sense is the usual explanation, not certain) | "straight-aimed", "far-flying", "wide-flying" (each decides the unknown second half) |
| μεσσοπαγὲς … ἔθηκε (21.172) | "fixed it to its middle" | "stuck … up to its middle" | "halfway", "buried to the middle"; μέσσος "middle" + πήγνυμι "fix" |
| κρημνοῖο (ἐκ κρημνοῖο ἐρύσσαι, 21.175) | "steep bank" | "steep bank" | "cliff", "crag", "overhang"; κρημνός "steep bank"; the same bank as ὄχθη (21.171), which keeps "bank" |
| χειρὶ παχείῃ (21.175) | "stout hand" | "stout hand" | "thick hand", "strong hand" (reserved for κρατερός), "heavy hand"; παχύς "stout, thick" |
| τρὶς δὲ μεθῆκε βίης (21.177) | "three times he let go of his strength" | "three times he eased off his strength" | "relaxed his grip", "gave up", "stopped trying"; μεθίημι "let go, relax" with the genitive |
| ἀπηύρα (θυμὸν, 21.179) | "took away" | "took" | "robbed" (the table’s 15.462 has the person as object; here θυμός is the object), "reft"; ἀπαυράω "take away" |
| τὸν δὲ σκότος ὄσσε κάλυψεν ἀσθμαίνοντ’ (21.181–182) | "and darkness covered his two eyes, / panting;" | "and darkness covered his eyes as he panted;" | "gasping" (ἀσθμαίνω is "panting" at 10.376, iliad-061 and iliad-081), "night", "black mist" (the Odyssey’s μέλαν νέφος); σκότος "darkness", ὄσσε "two eyes" (dual) |
| τεύχεά τ’ ἐξενάριξε καὶ εὐχόμενος ἔπος ηὔδα (21.183; the first half-line, ἐνὶ στήθεσσιν ὀρούσας, is new here) | "and Achilles, upon his chest springing, / despoiled the armour, and, declaring, spoke a word:" | "and Achilles sprang on his chest, stripped off his armour and said, declaring aloud:" | "leaping" (kept for ἅλλομαι); the published 13.618 English kept for line 183; ὀρούσας "springing" / "sprang", as in the published ὀρούσας |
| κεῖσ’ οὕτως (21.184) | "Lie there so" | "Lie there just as you are" | "Lie there thus", "Stay there"; the same word κεῖσο as 21.122 (the `l` of the pair follows ἐνταυθοῖ … κεῖσο "Lie there") |
| ἐρισθενέος Κρονίωνος (21.184) | "of the son of Cronus, great in strength" | "of the son of Cronus, great in strength" | "Cronus’ son" (the table’s Κρονίων is "the son of Cronus"), "mighty", "strong-willed"; follows the Odyssey table’s ἐρισθενής "great in strength" (19.355) |
| ποταμοῖό περ ἐκγεγαῶτι (21.185) | "though sprung from a river" | "though sprung from a river" | "born of", "begotten by"; ἐκγίγνομαι "be sprung from", used of Zeus’ line and the river’s |
| γένος · γενεήν (21.186–187, 21.157, 21.190–191) | "race" · "lineage" | "race" · "lineage" | "family" (kept for οἶκος), "offspring", "stock", "birth"; γενεή is "lineage" at 21.153, 21.157 and 21.190–191 (table, 6.145) |
| εὔχομαι εἶναι (21.187) | "I claim … to be" | "I claim that … is" | "I declare" (the Odyssey table’s εὔχομαι), "I pray" (the prayer sense), "I boast" (decides the tone); follows the Iliad table’s εὔχομαι εἶναι "claim" (2.82, 3.430, 4.264) |
| ἀνάσσων Μυρμιδόνεσσι (21.188) | "being lord over many Myrmidons" | "who is lord over many Myrmidons" | "king of", "ruling"; ἀνάσσω "be lord" (1.180, 4.61), the participle kept in `l` |
| Αἰακίδης (of Peleus, 21.189) | "descendant of Aeacus" | "descendant of Aeacus" | "son of Aeacus" (kept out of `l` and `i` because the table’s Αἰακίδης is "descendant", for Achilles); the note says Peleus was Aeacus’ son |
| Αἰακίδαο (of Achilles, 21.178) | "of the descendant of Aeacus" | "of Achilles" (the name replaces the patronymic) | "grandson of Aeacus"; follows the table’s Αἰακίδης "descendant of Aeacus" (11.805) |
| ἁλιμυρηέντων (ποταμῶν, 21.190) | "sea-flowing" | "that run to the sea" (+ note: the second half is not certain) | "salt" (decides one sense), "brine-flowing", "briny"; ἅλς "sea" + a root "flow" |
| κρείων Ἀχελώϊος (21.194) | "lord Achelous" | "lord Achelous" | "mighty", "ruling"; follows the table’s κρείων "lord" (κρείων Ἀγαμέμνων "lord Agamemnon", 1.130) |
| ἰσοφαρίζει (21.194) | "compares himself" | "matches" | "can compare" (adds a "can"), "vies with", "makes himself equal"; ἴσος "equal" + φέρω |
| βαθυρρείταο … Ὠκεανοῖο (21.195) | "deep-flowing Oceanus" | "deep-flowing Oceanus" | "deep-streaming", "deep-running"; follows the table’s βαθύρροος "deep-flowing" (11.13) |
| φρείατα μακρά (21.197) | "long wells" | "deep wells" | "great wells", "tall wells"; μακρός "long" of a well is "deep" |
| σμαραγήσῃ (21.199; the thunder resounding) | "resounds" | "resounds" | "crashes", "rumbles", "roars", "peals"; follows the table’s σμαραγεῖ "resounds" (2.463), the subject left unnamed |
| ἔσσεται ἢ ἠὼς ἢ δείλη ἢ μέσον ἦμαρ (21.111) | "there will be either a dawn or an evening or a midday" | "there will come a dawn or an evening or a midday" | "or noon" (μέσον ἦμαρ is "mid-day"), "afternoon" (δείλη is the late day generally); the three times of day as a set |
| ὁππότε … ἐκ θυμὸν ἕληται … Ἄρῃ (21.112) | "when someone shall take from me also my life, in war" | "when some man will take my life from me too in war" | "by Ares" (the god, which the Greek does not mean), "in battle"; Ἄρης "war" |
| ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ὀϊστῷ (21.113) | "an arrow from the bowstring" | "an arrow from the bowstring" | "from the string of the bow"; -φιν "from"; ὀϊστός "arrow" as in the table |
| γούνατα … λύτο (21.114; whole line, with the Odyssey’s English from 24.345) | "So he spoke, and then his knees were loosed, and his dear heart;" | "So he spoke, and his knees gave way at once, and his heart too;" | the Odyssey’s wording kept; the line is not a whole unit in the Odyssey, so no identity is required |
| ἐπευχόμενος (21.121) | "and over him, vaunting, winged words he spoke:" (line as at iliad-107, 5.119) | "in triumph over him" | "declaring over him" (the earlier draft; the table’s εὐχόμενος "declaring" is another word), "boasting", "gloating"; follows the table’s ἐπευχόμενος `l` "vaunting", `i` "in triumph" |
| γοήσεται (21.124) | "will lament" | "lament" (and "will not lay you on a bed and lament you") | "mourn", "bewail", "weep for" (reserved for κλαίω words); γοάω "wail for" |
| λεχέεσσι (21.124) | "a bed" | "a bed" | "bier" (kept for φέρτρον, 18.236), "couch"; follows the table’s λεχέεσσι "bed" (18.233, 18.352); the note says it is the bier |
| λισσόμενος (21.98) | "begging" | "begging" | "entreating" (kept for γουνούμενος); follows the table’s λισσόμενος "begging" (16.46) |
| πιφαύσκεο (21.99) | "make known" | "talk … of" (rebuilt in the sentence) | "declare"; follows the table’s πιφαύσκω "make known" (10.478) |
| Ἰλίου προπάροιθεν · Ἴλιον (21.104, 21.156) | "before Ilios" · "to Ilios" | "before Ilios" · "to Ilios" | "Ilium" (kept for Ἴλιος ἱρή); follows the table’s Ἰλιόθι πρό "Ilios" (8.561) |
| Ἰλίου ἱρῆς (21.128) | "sacred Ilium" | "sacred Ilium" | "holy Ilium" ("holy" is reserved for ἠγάθεος); follows the table’s Ἴλιος ἱρή "sacred Ilium" (4.46) |
| ὀλοφύρεαι (21.106) | "grieve" | "grieve" | "lament", "mourn"; follows the table’s ὀλοφύρομαι "grieve" (8.33, 16.450) |
| ἀγαθοῖο (πατρὸς, 21.109) | "good" | "good" | "noble"; follows the table’s ἀγαθός "good" (2.819, 2.272) |
| ξίφος ἄμφηκες (21.118) | "the double-edged sword" | "the whole double-edged sword" | "two-edged" (the earlier draft); follows the table’s ξίφος ἄμφηκες "double-edged" (16.80) |
| δεῦε (γαῖαν, 21.119) | "wet" | "soaked" | "drenched"; follows the table’s δεύω `l` "wet", `i` "soaked" (13.655) |
| μίγη (τῇ … ποταμός, 21.143) | "was mingled" | "had lain with her" | "had lain" in `l`, "had intercourse"; follows the table’s μίγη "was mingled" (5.126, 3.445), `i` "lay with" |
| ἀντίος (21.144, 21.150) | "opposite" | "facing him" · "come against me" | "facing" in `l`; follows the table’s ἀντίος "opposite" (6.53, 11.594) |
| ἀντιόωσι (21.151) | "meet my might" | "meet my might" | "face", "come up against"; follows the table’s ἀντιάω "meet" (6.127) |
| κλυτὸν ἔγχεϊ (21.159) | "famous with the spear" | "famous for his spear" | "famed"; follows the table’s δουρὶ κλυτός "famous with the spear" (2.645) |
| ἐριζέμεναι (21.185) | "to quarrel" | "to quarrel" | "to strive", "to contend"; follows the table’s ἐριζέμεναι "to quarrel" (2.214, 6.131) |
| κρείσσων (21.190–191) | "stronger" | "stronger" | "mightier"; the table’s κρείσσων (16.688) |
| χύντο (21.181) | "poured" | "poured" | "spilled"; as in the published 4.525 (iliad-026) |
| δεινήν … βροντήν (21.199) | "dread thunder" | "dread thunder" | "terrible", "dreadful"; δεινός keeps "dread" (1.200, 7.245) |
| Διὶ Κρονίωνι (21.193) | "Zeus, the son of Cronus" | "Zeus, son of Cronus" | "Cronus’ son"; the table’s Κρονίων "the son of Cronus" |

Reused without change from the tables, listed for the reviewer: δῖος Ἀχιλλεύς "heavenly Achilles"; ποδάρκης δῖος Ἀχιλλεύς "swift-footed, heavenly Achilles"; ἔπεα πτερόεντα ἀγόρευεν "spoke winged words" (the table’s 3.155 row); δολιχόσκιον ἔγχος "long-shadowed spear"; Πηλιάδα μελίην "the Pelian ash-spear" (16.143); μείλινον ἔγχος "ashen spear"; μώνυχας ἵππους "solid-hoofed horses"; βαθυδίνης "deep-eddying"; δινήεις "eddying"; κελαινεφές "dark as a cloud" (4.140); μέλαν αἷμα "dark blood"; χολάδες "bowels" (4.526); ὠτειλή "wound"; μοῖρα κραταιή "strong fate" (5.83); αἴσιμον ἦμαρ "fated day" (8.72); ἄποινα "ransom"; νήπιε "foolish one" (18.295); δυστήνων … παῖδες "the sons of wretched men" (6.127); Πηλεΐδη "son of Peleus"; μεγάθυμε "great-hearted"; φαίδιμος "glorious"; ἐριβώλου "rich-soiled"; εὐρὺ ῥέοντος (Ἀξιοῦ) "wide-flowing" (2.849); ἄορ "sword", ξίφος "sword"; σάκος "shield"; ἔγχος "spear"; χεῖρε "hands"; φρεσί "wits"; μενεαίνων "eager".

Published-unit identities honoured: 21.148–149 is a whole unit with the published English of 20.176–177 (iliad-128). 21.114 reuses the Odyssey’s English of 24.345 (odyssey-118), not a whole unit there. 21.183 reuses the published English of the second line of 13.618 (iliad-083) in part, with the first half-line new: "stripped off his armour and said, declaring aloud:" is kept, and "Achilles leapt on his chest" is added before it.
